Package neqsim.process.corrosion

Class FlowAcceleratedCorrosionResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.corrosion.FlowAcceleratedCorrosionResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class FlowAcceleratedCorrosionResult extends Object implements Serializable
Result of a FlowAcceleratedCorrosion screening calculation.

The susceptibility index is meaningful only in comparison with another case. The most useful output for an investigation is usually getDominantFactor(), which names the lever that actually controls the outcome, and ratioTo(FlowAcceleratedCorrosionResult), which quantifies the effect of a proposed change.

1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • FlowAcceleratedCorrosionResult

      public FlowAcceleratedCorrosionResult(double velocityMs, double hydraulicDiameterM, double temperatureC, double inSituPH, FacGeometry geometry, double chromiumMassPercent, double reynolds, double schmidt, double sherwood, double massTransferCoefficientMs, double wallShearStressPa, double temperatureFactor, double phFactor, double geometryFactor, double chromiumFactor, double susceptibilityIndex, List<String> warnings)
      Construct a FAC screening result.
      Parameters:
      velocityMs - bulk velocity in m/s
      hydraulicDiameterM - hydraulic diameter in m
      temperatureC - local temperature in C
      inSituPH - in-situ pH at operating temperature
      geometry - local geometry class
      chromiumMassPercent - chromium content of the steel in wt%
      reynolds - Reynolds number, dimensionless
      schmidt - Schmidt number, dimensionless
      sherwood - Sherwood number, dimensionless
      massTransferCoefficientMs - mass-transfer coefficient in m/s
      wallShearStressPa - wall shear stress in Pa
      temperatureFactor - temperature factor, dimensionless
      phFactor - pH factor, dimensionless
      geometryFactor - geometry enhancement factor, dimensionless
      chromiumFactor - chromium factor, dimensionless
      susceptibilityIndex - the combined screening index
      warnings - list of warnings; may be null

      public double ratioTo(FlowAcceleratedCorrosionResult other)
